messages:
ana_cs: Heads-up: customer LumaCare (acct LC-900) reported invoice INV-9123 failed on their end. Stripe shows `do_not_honor` for charge ch_0aB1cD. They messaged asking for ACH but are EU-based and want IBAN. Putting thread here to confirm our international ACH/wire flow.

kevin_finance: Thanks Ana. We normally provide wire + SEPA if customer is EU. For SEPA we need IBAN + BIC. Do we offer SEPA as standard? @toni_ops

toni_ops: We support SEPA wires. Our usual templates:
```
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd.
IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
BIC/SWIFT: NWBKGB2L
Reference: INV-9123
```
Note: for SEPA the funds often clear same-day or next business day depending on bank.

mila_revops: Also, we need to flag the account so our billing automation doesn't attempt card retries or suspend services. Add `international_manual_pay` tag with 14d TTL.

ana_cs: (typo) ana_cs: I'll send the SEPA instructions. They asked whether we can absorb incoming intermediary fees 75. They said their bank charges a large correspondent fee.

kevin_finance: Policy: we cover up to $50 by default for inbound bank fees. For > $50 escalate to finance leads. @mila_revops can you approve one-time exception to $75?

mila_revops: We can approve up to $75 as a one-time courtesy for strategic accounts. Mark invoice as "manual_payment_pending" and include the fee cap.

intel-payments-bot: Tag applied: `no_auto_retry` on acct LC-900 for 14d (set by mila_revops).

stripe-bot: Scheduled retries canceled for charge `ch_0aB1cD` (requested by ana_cs).

ana_cs: Email to LumaCare (sent):
"Hi Marta We've paused further card attempts. Because you're EU-based, please use SEPA/wire and include the bank receipt when complete. We'll reimburse up to $75 of incoming bank fees for this payment as a one-time courtesy. SEPA details below. If you prefer we can also take a new card when you're ready.

SEPA/WIRE:
Beneficiary: Redwood Inference Ltd.
IBAN: GB29NWBK60161331926819
BIC/SWIFT: NWBKGB2L
Reference: INV-9123

Please reply with the confirmation/receipt so we can reconcile immediately.
"

kevin_finance: Perfect. I'll update the billing playbook entry for `do_not_honor` international cases to include SEPA template + fee exception process. Also logging this exception under FIN-5023.

toni_ops: Created ops ticket FIN-5023 to monitor reconciliation and webhook suppression. I'll watch for any retry webhooks and ensure none fire for 14d.

mila_revops: One note: if they claim fees > $75, CS should ask for a screenshot of bank fees and escalate to finance-leads; otherwise honor up to $75.

ana_cs: Will do. Closing here unless they ask to re-run card or request further concessions.

kevin_finance: Thanks team  Closing thread.
